categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies AddrMan address freshness logic in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a logic bug where AddrMan's freshness check ignores the initial time penalty, inflating address multiplicity in the new table upon receiving identical relayed announcements. As the author notes, this is a minor logic bugfix rather than an adversarial defense, since attackers can alter timestamps directly.
